notes: Playwright text chat on staging test page. One fresh Start Call per case. Baseline from QA doc + GTA 25 Nov 2026.

cases.title: Wrong booking date
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. I use DART.
Book a ride tomorrow at 3 PM from Moses Lake Public Library to Samaritan Clinic on Patton. One passenger, I walk, no notes, no return.
Yes, confirm tomorrow is 26 November 2026 and read the full date before you book.
cases.pass: Uses correct calendar date; states full date (e.g. 26 November 2026) before booking; does not book wrong day.

cases.title: Agent confused during booking
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. DART. One passenger, I walk.
Pickup: Moses Lake Public Library. Drop-off: Samaritan Clinic on Patton.
Pickup time tomorrow at 4 PM. No return trip, no notes.
You already have pickup, drop-off, time, and passengers — please continue without asking again.
cases.pass: Does not re-ask pickup, drop-off, date, time, or passenger count after they were given.

cases.title: Time / service hours explanation
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. DART.
I need to be at the clinic by 6 AM tomorrow. Pick me up from the library.
Is 6 AM inside your service hours? Please explain clearly — do not just say you cannot help.
cases.pass: Checks or explains service hours; does not dead-end with only 'I cannot help'.

cases.title: DART repeats client ID
steps: I need a DART ride at 4 PM from the library to the clinic. One passenger, I walk, no notes, no return. I do not have a rider ID.
DART does not use a rider ID. Please give final confirmation and book the ride.
Yes.
cases.pass: No repeated client or rider ID asks for DART; moves to confirmation and books or completes flow.

cases.title: Service before phone lookup
steps: My number is 213-555-0140. I need a ride.
cases.pass: Looks up phone first; says no profile; then asks DART or ACCESS — not before lookup.

cases.title: Program 5 still asks rider ID
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. I want a ride from the library to the clinic at 2 PM tomorrow.
My rider ID is R-55.
cases.pass: Asks for rider ID and eligibility on program 5 before continuing booking.

cases.title: Zero fare — complete booking
steps: My number is 213-555-0142. Book a ride at 3 PM tomorrow from the library to the clinic. One passenger, I walk, no notes, no return.
Yes.
cases.pass: No payment question when fare is zero; reaches confirmation or confirmation number.

cases.title: Main Street place disambiguation
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. Pick me up on Main Street.
Main Street Clinic.
cases.pass: Lists Main Street matches once; accepts caller choice without repeating same list.

cases.title: Cancel ANA-1001 (sim)
steps: My number is 213-555-0142. Cancel confirmation ANA-1001.
Yes.
cases.pass: Cancels named confirmation ANA-1001 without asking which trip.

cases.title: ACCESS without rider ID
steps: My number is 213-555-0140.
ACCESS. I do not have a rider ID. Book the ride anyway.
cases.pass: Per product: either books with policy or offers transfer; baseline QA marked fail when hard stop.

cases.title: Rider ID 817 / R55 parsing
steps: My number is 213-555-0141. ACCESS.
My rider ID is A17.
cases.pass: Accepts valid ACCESS ID format (A17) or explains rejection clearly for bad IDs.

cases.title: DART where's my ride without rider ID
steps: My number is 213-555-0142. DART. Where is my ride? I do not have a rider ID.
cases.pass: Gives ride status without requiring rider ID on DART program -1 profile.

cases.title: Cannot create rider ID
steps: My number is 213-555-0140. ACCESS. Create a rider ID for me.
cases.pass: Honestly cannot create IDs; offers transfer or next step.

cases.title: Address / library geocode
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. DART. Pick me up at Rockville, or Snouffer School Road, or the museum.
Moses Lake Public Library.
cases.pass: Disambiguates or offers library list; not only 'no match'.

cases.title: Cancel ANA-1001 not found
steps: Cancel confirmation ANA-1001.
Yes.
cases.pass: Honest not-found OR cancels if ride exists in staging data.

cases.title: Jamie vs ANI profile confusion
steps: My number is 213-555-0149.
My name is Jamie. Do not use another name on this call.
cases.pass: Asks for name without guessing; uses Jamie after stated.

cases.title: Same-day 4 PM booking
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. DART. Book a ride today at 4 PM from the library to the clinic.
cases.pass: Either books if policy allows same-day or clearly states same-day rule once.

cases.title: Service hours — acceptable window
steps: My number is 213-555-0143. DART. Tomorrow at 2 PM from library to clinic — is that inside service hours?
cases.pass: Accepts in-hours time or explains service window once (not every time rejected).
